Highly recommend this one!

reviews.title: My 1+ Year Usage Review
reviews.text: I have been using this app for over a year now and it’s a very good app.  However, it can be much better because anything consumed doesn’t always update the main screen.  At this time, I need to tap History and tap Hydrate to see the updated totals.  Next, how does one determine the hydration factor impact for soy milk because this doesn’t appear to be a standard option in the app?  Furthermore, Reminders need to be simplified to something like every half hour, hour, and other value entered by the user.  BTW, this could be similar to the Podcast app.  Also, I should be able to receive these reminders only during certain interval during the day and the reminder should tell me how much to actually drink to meet my daily goal.  It would be nice if I could say, ‘Hey Siri, log 8 oz of water’ or similar phrase but I know that Siri is very limited in its abilities to do anything at this time.  In summary, this is a very good application for tracking my fluid intake per day but there are a few enhancements that I feel would make this app even better.

reviews.title: Most Useful App I Own
reviews.text:
I absolutely love the way this app is designed. The customization options are unmatched — you can tailor every beverage, choose the exact ounce amount, color‑code each drink, and build your own personalized list for quick logging.

The reminders are genuinely helpful, and the Apple Watch integration makes tracking your intake so much more convenient throughout the day. You can add the WaterMinder widget to your Apple Watch Home Screen, get optional notifications reminding you to drink, log your beverage right from your wrist, and visually track your progress throughout the day on whichever device you’re using. You can also choose how your progress is displayed — percentage, ounces consumed, or ounces remaining to reach your goal.

Having all of these options available is something I really appreciate.

Overall, it’s one of the most useful apps I’ve ever had, especially if you’re someone who likes things organized, customizable, and visually clean.

reviews.title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely love this app!
reviews.text:
I use WaterMinder every single day, and I honestly recommend it to everyone I know.

A huge turning point for me was reading The Water Cure by Dr. Batmanghelidj. That book completely changed the way I thought about hydration and, honestly, changed my life.

I used to be chronically dehydrated, and I eventually realized just how much my water intake was affecting how I felt and my overall health. One of the biggest changes I made was dramatically increasing my water intake and, more importantly, staying consistent with it.

My triglycerides were once around 1,200. Now they’re frequently under 90. I made multiple changes along the way, so I certainly wouldn’t attribute that entire transformation to water alone, but improving my hydration was a huge part of my journey — and WaterMinder was a major reason I was able to stay on track every single day.

The reminders, tracking, daily goals, and simple visual feedback make it incredibly easy to stay accountable. What used to be something I constantly forgot about is now just part of my daily routine.

I tell everyone about this app because it actually works for me. It took something as simple as drinking water and turned it into a habit I could consistently follow.

If you struggle to drink enough water, get WaterMinder. Seriously. It has become one of those apps I use constantly and would hate to be without.

5 stars without hesitation. 💧💧💧

And if you haven’t read The Water Cure, I highly recommend giving it a read. It completely changed the way I look at hydration.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text:
Let me first say: I’m old. When I was a child my mom restricted all my liquid intake due to misunderstood warnings about diabetes. 

Until a few years ago, I didn’t realize how badly I withheld liquids which made many illnesses worse: dried up sinuses=headaches, dry/itchy skin, and so on. An autoimmune illness brought dry-mouth into play & I realized I had to change my liquid intake or matters would get worse.

I tried unsuccessfully several ways to keep track of my daily intake until I came across WaterMinder! WOW!
It is so easy to personalize to my needs and to keep track not only of my overall liquid intake but also what type of drinks I consume during the day. 
There are also several icons to choose from. They show in color how much/type of drink I had that day, how much was still left to consume, and even congratulates to an accomplished goal. 

A few years ago several books were written about our bodies many cries for water. It helps flush out toxins & waste products, keeps skin supple, gives us that glow of well maintained hair & skin. 
Take a close up picture of your face prior to increased fluid intake (you set your own goal!), follow your regimen a couple of months, take another picture & discover the difference adequate liquids make! 

It is also very important for people who have to take daily medications! Water aids liver & kidneys to flush residues out instead of depositing it in our (mainly) fat.

WaterMinder is the easiest way to keep track not only of daily intakes but also long-term in a very efficient way. Connected to a smart-watch makes it even easier.

WaterMinder is the best I’ve found in all apps at an incredible price. I highly recommend it.
